name: Indy 4
notes: Single source. Every one of the 30 devices comes from the IC parts list in TM-055, and that is the only printing of this manual in the corpus that carries the list. No component-location drawing has been read. Nothing here has been checked against a second source, which is the test every other board on this site has passed, and the board page says so.

The grid spacing is nominal — the designators are what the parts list gives, but nothing has measured the board. Rows run L to A and columns 1 to 6; the row span is the standard Atari alphabet between the outermost letters seen, so rows with no device on them are still drawn as positions the board has.
conflicts: Devices withdrawn 2026-09-02. These cells were claimed twice by the same parts list, and merge_ic_locations took whichever reading came last — locations() detected the collision and returned it, but harvest() discarded that half of the answer. So each of these was one of two readings picked by position in the file rather than by evidence. They are off the map until something settles them. The withdrawn readings are kept here because a repairer at the bench is better served by 'it is one of these two' than by silence: A3 (7474/7493); B3 (7474/9312); H2 (74174/9322).

MAME's ROM map, whose file names encode board positions and were checked against real boards, puts a ROM at F4 (005503.f4). The parts list here reads 7400 — a logic device — at that cell. Only one printing is in the corpus, so this is one OCR read against a position verified on hardware; the map keeps the parts-list reading by house rule but the odds favour MAME. Needs a second printing or a board.
